tests.name: Upload a 5 MB file
tests.expected: 5 chunks, each stored on 2 different nodes
tests.observed: 5 chunks, 10 copies on 2 different nodes each; copies per node 5001: 4, 5002: 3, 5003: 3; upload took 0.03 s

tests.name: Download with all nodes running
tests.observed: SHA-256 matches the original (9fb8166b41a9...); download took 0.01 s

tests.name: Stop one storage node, then download
tests.observed: node 5002 stopped; file complete in 0.01 s, 1 of 5 chunks read from their second copy; checksum matches

tests.name: Keep the node stopped for 10+ seconds
tests.expected: Master marks it dead and copies its chunks to a healthy node
tests.observed: marked dead after 10.6 s without a heartbeat (10.2 s after it stopped); 3 lost copies re-created on healthy nodes 0.03 s later; every chunk back to 2 live copies

tests.name: Stop a second node after re-replication
tests.observed: nodes 5002 and 5003 both down; all 5 chunks read from node 5001; checksum matches

tests.name: Restart both stopped nodes (extra)
tests.expected: Nodes rejoin, 2 live copies again, stale copies removed
tests.observed: both nodes rejoined; every chunk has 2 live copies; 3 stale copies deleted from node 5002; checksum still matches

tests.name: Upload 10 files of different sizes
tests.expected: Chunks spread roughly evenly across the 3 nodes
tests.observed: 10 files (0.3-10 MB), 45 chunks, 90 copies: node 5001: 30, node 5002: 30, node 5003: 30; all 10 files download with matching checksums
